text: dsh-engineering-workflow 是面向 DSH 命令行宿主的工程工作流预设插件。它通过 profile bundle 注册宿主插件，在启动时将内置预设同步到 DSH home 的 .agent-presets 目录，并可向 system prompt 添加工作流说明。预设包含需求澄清、计划审批、TDD 实现、子 Agent 并行执行和验证收尾五个阶段，并附带总纲及五个阶段技能。适合希望在 DSH 编码任务中采用明确阶段门禁、测试驱动实现和并行协作流程的用户。无需额外 API key 或外部服务；可用配置关闭插件或提示注入，也可用 DSH_HOME 指定 DSH 主目录。

dsh-engineering-workflow adds a DSH preset for requirements, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagents, and verified finishing. Its host plugin syncs six workflow skills on startup and can add guidance to the system prompt. No API key is required.
我想让 DSH 写代码前先把需求问清楚并等我确认。
有没有办法要求编码代理先提交计划，获批后再开始实现？
想让 DSH 按测试先行的方式完成开发任务。
多个独立编码任务能不能交给子代理并行做，同时保留审查记录？
我希望代理在说任务完成前，先拿出刚运行得到的验证依据。
Can my coding agent clarify requirements and wait for approval before changing code?
I want an approved plan and test-first implementation for my DSH coding tasks.
dsh-engineering-workflow 的需求澄清阶段：开始实现前先分类任务、提出澄清问题并等待用户明确批准，适用于需要先对齐范围的编码工作。
dsh-engineering-workflow 的计划审批阶段：在 plan mode 编写实施计划，通过 exit_plan_mode 请求批准；获批后才进入编码。
dsh-engineering-workflow 的 TDD 阶段：要求先写一个能复现需求的失败测试，再实现代码并经过绿灯与重构，避免跳过测试直接交付。
dsh-engineering-workflow 的子代理阶段：将独立任务并行派发给后台子代理，维护任务账本，并在整合前逐项审查结果。
dsh-engineering-workflow 的验证收尾阶段：结束任务前收集新鲜测试或检查证据，再按分支状态呈现后续处理选项。
想让代理在结束前检查变更，并给出提交或保留分支等收尾选择。

An engineering workflow layer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh). One install adds the **工程工作流 (Engineering Workflow)** agent preset — a disciplined-engineer mode with five hard-gated phases — plus six workflow skills that carry the methodology.

dsh-engineering-workflow README · dsh-engineering-workflow：The workflow methodology is adapted from [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) (MIT): brainstorming, writing-plans, TDD, subagent-driven development, and verification-before-completion, reworked for dsh's native tools (plan mode + `exit_plan_mode`, background `subagent`/`subagent_fork`, `workflow` orchestration, goals, and the preset/skill system).

dsh-engineering-workflow README · The five phases：| Phase | Skill | Gate | dsh mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ① Requirements clarification | `workflow-requirements` | Intent approved before any code | `ask_user_question`, one question at a time |
| ② Plan approval | `workflow-planning` | Plan approved via `exit_plan_mode` | plan mode, `todo_write` after approval |
| ③ TDD implementation | `workflow-tdd` | Failing test before production code | `pwsh`/`bash` test runs |
| ④ Parallel subagent execution | `workflow-subagents` | Per-task review + ledger | background `subagent`, `send_message`, `list_agents` |
| ⑤ Verified finishing | `workflow-verification` | Fresh evidence before claims | full suite + branch-finish menu |

dsh-engineering-workflow README · The five phases：The master skill `engineering-workflow` routes every non-trivial task to the right phase and enforces the discipline rules (rationalization red flags included).

dsh-engineering-workflow README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:82c86b8z86-stack/dsh-engineering-workflow
```

(Or `npm install` the package into your profile and add `dsh-engineering-workflow` to `dsh.profile.bundles`.)

Restart dsh once so the host plugin mounts. On startup it syncs the preset into `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/engineering-workflow`; the preset then appears in the new-session preset picker as **工程工作流**. The sync is idempotent — upgrading the plugin updates the preset and its skills automatically.

dsh-engineering-workflow README · Install：Manual / development fallback without a restart:

```sh
node scripts/sync-presets.mjs
```

dsh re-discovers presets on every roster read, so the synced preset is selectable immediately.

dsh-engineering-workflow README · How it works：```
dsh-engineering-workflow (bundle)
├── cordis.patch.yml        inserts one host plugin row
└── lib/index.js            host plugin: syncs presets/ → ~/.dsh/.agent-presets,
│                           announces the workflow via a system-prompt section

dsh-engineering-workflow README · How it works：The preset wires its skills through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` with `customSkillDirs` rooted at the preset's own directory — the same pattern the shipped `cordis` preset uses, so the skill catalog travels with the preset wherever it is installed.

dsh-engineering-workflow README · Verify the install：```sh
node scripts/verify-install.mjs

dsh-engineering-workflow README · ✓ engineering-workflow: current (byte-identical)：```

This compares the bundled preset against `~/.dsh/.agent-presets` without writing anything. If it reports `stale` or `missing`, run `node scripts/sync-presets.mjs` (or restart dsh once so the host plugin syncs on mount).

Where the plugin takes effect:

dsh-engineering-workflow README · ✓ engineering-workflow: current (byte-identical)：- The **preset picker** (new-session dialog) lists **工程工作流** — dsh re-discovers presets on every roster read, so a synced preset appears without a restart. Pick it for a new session; existing sessions and the default preset are never switched.
- The **system-prompt announcement** (the workflow guidance the model reads) appears in sessions created after the host plugin mounted — i.e. after the first dsh restart following the install.
- The six workflow skills load with the preset and are invocable via the `skill` tool in those sessions.
